title: The integration seam for Paperless is an endpoint plus a webhook
content:
Step three of the scenario is stated in two lines: set endpoint, configure webhook.

A configuration-only seam is what makes the channel strategy viable. If integrating required patching or forking the companion product, every consultancy deployment would carry a maintenance burden that the consultancy — not Powerhouse — would have to own, and the offer would stop being an easy addition to an existing proposition.

It also matches what the tool screen found elsewhere: the tools worth integrating with expose webhooks, hooks or event listeners as first-class configuration, and that seam is usually available in the freely-licensed edition.
description: Enabling the integration requires only setting an endpoint and configuring a webhook — no source modification of the companion product.
